$comment: Config for the weekly curation agents (/open-mic-scout and /stale-event-sweep). Edit freely — add regions, add/remove categories. Both commands read this file at run time.

openMicScout.$comment: Categories the scout web-searches for in each enabled region. Expand this list to widen coverage.

staleEventSweep.$comment: What the freshness sweep flags. gracePeriodDays: how long after end/start a PUBLISHED event may linger before it's flagged as needing COMPLETED/ARCHIVED.
